description_expanded: Located just off of 30A, Catch a Wave features gorgeous interiors, a private pool, a 6-seater golf cart, and more! Just a short walk from the beach, this stunning vacation home in Santa Rosa Beach makes for the perfect family getaway! Prepare delightful meals in the beautifully appointed kitchen while the kids head to the entertainment room to play games and watch their favorite cartoons. Spend lazy days by the pool, then take the golf cart to the beach to catch incredible sunsets each evening. With two master suites featuring en suite baths, a bunk room for the kids, a private balcony, and a full-sized washer and dryer, everyone is assured a peaceful and relaxing stay! *NOTE: Pool heating is available for an additional fee. Catch a Wave is close to popular restaurants and just minutes away from several others, including Perfect Pig Fish & Grill House, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, Basmati’s Asian Cuisine, Mimmo’s Ristorante Italiano, Local Catch Bar & Grill, and Goatfeathers. Nearby family-friendly attractions include Topsail Hill Preserve State Park, The Village of Baytowne Wharf, Point Washington State Forest, Eden Gardens State Park, and four championship golf courses in nearby Sandestin. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. *Please note: Maximum parking for 3 cars.
